title: 2019 AMC 12A Problem 12
statement: Positive real numbers \(x \ne 1\) and \(y \ne 1\) satisfy \(\log_2 x = \log_y 16\) and \(xy = 64.\) What is \(\left(\log_2 \dfrac{x}{y}\right)^2?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(a = \log_2 x\) and \(b = \log_2 y.\) Then \(\log_y 16 = \dfrac{4}{b},\) so \(a = \dfrac{4}{b},\) giving \(ab = 4.\)

Since \(xy = 64,\) we have \(a + b = 6.\)

Therefore \[ \begin{aligned} \left(\log_2 \tfrac{x}{y}\right)^2 &= (a - b)^2 \\ &= (a + b)^2 - 4ab \\ &= 36 - 16 = 20. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: You get \(ab = 4\) and \(a + b = 6;\) note \(\left(\log_2\tfrac{x}{y}\right)^2 = (a - b)^2\)
